name: E02_5_crossway_troublemakers_declined_pays_nothing_draws_nothing
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Whenever a Vampire you control dies, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.' Seat 0's Vampire dies to seat 1's Ogre. Seat 0 declines the may (skip): no life is paid (20) and, since it did not pay, no card is drawn (hand stays 0).
